thesis: Rayonier Inc. is a timberland real estate investment trust that owns and manages forests, sells logs and wood products, and monetizes higher-and-better-use (HBU) land. **[Fact]** On January 30, 2026 Rayonier completed a merger-of-equals with PotlatchDeltic Corporation, creating a combined company with approximately **4.1 million acres** of timberlands in the U.S. South (**3.2 million acres**) and U.S. Northwest (**930 thousand acres**), plus six sawmills and an expanded real estate development platform. **[Fact]** The company reports four segments: Southern Timber, Pacific Northwest Timber, Wood Products, and Real Estate. **[Fact]** Q1 2026 revenue was **$276.8 million**; total Adjusted EBITDA was **$94.1 million**; Cash Available for Distribution (CAD) was **$90.2 million** and Adjusted CAD (after **$27.5 million** mandatory debt repayments) was **$62.7 million**. **[Fact]** At March 31, 2026 the balance sheet showed **$7.75 billion** in total assets, **$5.87 billion** in timber and timberlands (net), **$1.86 billion** in long-term debt, **$682 million** in cash, and stockholders equity of **$5.33 billion** (**~301.7 million** common shares outstanding).
why_market_wrong: The market may still price RYN as pre-merger standalone Rayonier (~2.8 million acres, timber-only) rather than as the larger integrated platform that now combines PotlatchDeltic sawmills, Chenal Valley real estate, and **4.1 million acres** of geographically diversified timberland. **[Fact]** Q1 2026 Real Estate segment Adjusted EBITDA was **$46.2 million** on **7,695 acres** sold (including a **2,226-acre** solar developer parcel at **$10,100** per acre), versus **$2.0 million** in the prior-year quarter on **1,031 acres**. **[Inference]** At **~$19.82** (May 2026 insider purchase price), the stock trades slightly above GAAP book equity of **~$17.66** per share, not at a deep land discount, yet the embedded HBU, carbon-capture, and solar lease options on Southern acreage may be under-modeled in run-rate earnings screens. **[Inference]** Predictive attribute: **timberland acreage REIT** plus **post-merger integration catalyst** (synergy realization on overhead, wood products, and capital allocation).
